items.title: Mazzulla on Neemias Queta making plays off the dribble in the Celtics' double-big lineups tonight:
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Mazzulla on Neemias Queta making plays off the dribble in the Celtics' double-big lineups tonight:

"The guys didn't know we were gonna do it, they hadn't practiced it.” They didn't know until right before the 2nd Qtr.

"Play-making is an area that we'd like to see Neemi take to a different level."

quote.author: KeithSmithNBA
quote.text: Given Payton Pritchard had two years left on his deal, I'm a little surprised an extension happened now vs next offseason. The $22M AAV shows how Boston values Pritchard as an important part of their rotation. He should return positive value on that contract without any doubt.
